machine.gpu: Virtual Desktop Monitor; Parsec Virtual Display Adapter; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090

idle_cpu_pct.note: idle percent of one core: floor of two clock ticks over 60 s

delta_mb.note: megabytes left behind by an open/close cycle: a difference of two readings, so it carries the noise of both (run1 27.3 vs run2 36.1 MB on 2026-11-14)

perf_rate.note: the app's GHOZTTY_PERF counters (reads, batches, renders, wakeups, fps per second; bytes per batch): rates set by the scheduler as much as by the code, so the wakeups tolerance

idle.method: 1 window 1400x900, 1 cmd pane at its prompt, persistence off; 10 s settle, then CPU time and summed thread context switches (NtQuerySystemInformation class 5) over 60 s; GPU Engine(pid_*) utilisation summed over engines, 1 s samples, first 30 s. cpu_pct is user+kernel tick-charged time (baselines 1-3: user only); cpu_cycle_pct is the exact cycle count at the nominal 3000 MHz (T3111)

wakeup_attribution.method: per-thread ContextSwitches (SystemProcessInformation) at both ends of the span; a thread's group is its start module (NtQueryInformationThread Win32StartAddress against the process's module list) plus its SetThreadDescription name; threads that exited inside the span are not counted; mcycles_per_s is QueryThreadCycleTime at both ends (exact, not tick-sampled; T3111)

busy.method: +split a cmd pane running `type` of a 64 MB file (108-char ASCII lines) then writing a marker; wall time from the split to the marker, app CPU over the same span; GPU Engine(pid_*) summed, 1 s samples

perf.method: GHOZTTY_PERF=1 in the app's environment; the app's own 1 s counter lines written over the busy span (Debug: stderr; release: the sandbox ghoztty.log) - pty reader (termio/Exec.zig), agent_feed (termio/Remote.zig, persistence on), queue_render (termio/stream_handler.zig), renderer wakeups (renderer/Thread.zig), fps (renderer/OpenGL.zig). Rates are the mean over the windows the busy pane produced; wakeups is the median over all renderer threads' windows; bytes_per_batch is total bytes / total batches

wakeup_attribution.method: per-thread ContextSwitches (SystemProcessInformation) at both ends of the span; a thread's group is its start module (NtQueryInformationThread Win32StartAddress against the process's module list) plus its SetThreadDescription name; threads that exited inside the span are not counted; mcycles_per_s is QueryThreadCycleTime at both ends (exact, not tick-sampled; T3111)

resize.method: SetWindowPos to a new size every 50 ms for 8 s (2 panes open, one holding the busy output); app CPU and GPU Engine over the span

cycle.method: one window, persistence off, cmd panes: settled sample (lib\ProcessMemory.ps1 Get-Sample + working set) at start, with 10 panes open over 3 tabs (ctrl+shift+t x2, then +split 3/2/2), and after +close of every added pane plus the 1 s undo window; cycles 1 and 2 as cycle1/cycle2, then the settle block (T3005) when -SettledCycles > 0. GPU memory is the GPU Process Memory counter set summed over adapters.

residue.method: object census (handle types: SystemExtendedHandleInformation + ObjectTypesInformation; windows: top-level, child and message-only windows of the pid on the test desktop, by class; threads: by start module and name) at start and after each cycle closed; user_non_window_delta = GetGuiResources(USER) delta minus window-count delta

settle.method: after cycles 1-2, warm-up cycles until two in a row each grow private bytes and GPU dedicated+shared memory by <= 2 MB (cap 8), then 5 measured cycles; slope = least-squares growth per cycle of the settled closed samples (the last warm-up closed sample plus each measured one). ~0 after settling = bounded fill; a steady positive slope = a leak

regions.method: VirtualQueryEx walk of every committed region, classed: heap = MEM_PRIVATE in an allocation whose base carries the NT heap segment (0xffeeffee) or segment heap (0xddeeddee) signature at +0x10; writecombine = MEM_PRIVATE with PAGE_WRITECOMBINE (the GPU driver upload pool); uncached = PAGE_NOCACHE; stack = an allocation holding a PAGE_GUARD region; private_rw = every other MEM_PRIVATE region (Zig page allocator incl. the Debug DebugAllocator, driver arenas, heap large blocks); mapped = MEM_MAPPED; image = MEM_IMAGE. Taken at start, after cycle 1 closed, at the settle start, after the last cycle closed, and closed-and-idle

gpa_leak_report.method: Debug build only: WM_SYSCOMMAND SC_CLOSE to the window after the last cycle (confirm-close off, persistence off, quit-after-last-window-closed on), wait up to 30 s for the process to exit, then count DebugAllocator leak lines ("leaked") on its stderr. Allocations live at exit, not per-cycle growth; read with the slope

viewer.method: one app (persistence off, 1 cmd pane); three viewers +split beside it in tab 1: a 60-section markdown file, git-status: on a scratch repo (1 modified, 1 untracked), and a static 120-paragraph page from a loopback listener. The WebView2 tree is every msedgewebview2.exe descending from the app, role from --type=; app figures are the app process alone

base.method: before any viewer: app settled, WebView2 tree (expected empty: the environment is created on the first viewer)

open.method: 3 viewers shown: the tree counted once its process count held for 3 s (cap 45 s) plus 5 s, app settled; then 15 s more and CPU over 60 s shown and idle (app: user+kernel; webview: per-process user+kernel, a process born in the span counted whole). growth = app minus base

hidden.method: ctrl+shift+t on the terminal opens tab 2 over the viewers' tab; 5 s, then CPU over 60 s (as in open) and the tree and app sampled at its end. viewer_windows_visible must be 0 (the viewers really are hidden); private_mb_change = tree now minus tree when open

after_close.method: +close the covering tab and all three viewers (to 1 pane), then the tree every 10 s for 90 s (series) and the residual tree and settled app at the end. leak = app at the end minus base (before any viewer); it includes what the covering tab's terminal pane left behind

agent.method: persistence on; agent started by a throwaway app, then measured: idle = 30 s CPU and context switches with 1 attached session; per-session = (private bytes, and its ConPTY/shell descendants' private bytes) delta after 4 +split panes divided by the +sessions --json delta; attach/detach = app killed (sessions stay pinned) then relaunched (restore re-attaches), 3 times, settled agent sample after each
